<ul style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; list-style: none; padding-left: 1.5em; margin-left: 0; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">

<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">• ✅ Hyper-V</li>

</li>

<h3 id="4" style="text-align: left; line-height: 2.4em; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 19.2px; padding-left: 12px; border-left: 4px solid rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); margin: 2em 8px 0.75em 0; color: hsl(var(--foreground)); font-weight: bold; border-radius: 6px" data-heading="true">方法二：PowerShell 命令安装</h3>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">以管理员身份打开 PowerShell，执行以下命令：</p>
<pre class="language-powershell highlighter-hljs"><code>#&nbsp;1.&nbsp;启用&nbsp;Hyper-V&nbsp;全套组件
Enable-WindowsOptionalFeature&nbsp;-Online&nbsp;-FeatureName&nbsp;Microsoft-Hyper-V-All&nbsp;-NoRestart

#&nbsp;2.&nbsp;启用"适用于&nbsp;Linux&nbsp;的&nbsp;Windows&nbsp;子系统"功能
Enable-WindowsOptionalFeature&nbsp;-Online&nbsp;-FeatureName&nbsp;Microsoft-Windows-Subsystem-Linux&nbsp;-NoRestart

#&nbsp;3.&nbsp;把&nbsp;WSL&nbsp;更新到最新内核（微软商店版，推荐）
wsl&nbsp;--update&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;#&nbsp;会自动下载安装&nbsp;Store&nbsp;版&nbsp;WSL</code></pre>
<blockquote style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: italic; padding: 1em 1em 1em 2em; border-left: 4px solid rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); border-radius: 6px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6); background: var(--blockquote-background); margin-bottom: 1em; border-bottom: 0.2px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04); border-top: 0.2px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04); border-right: 0.2px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04)">
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 1em; display: block; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">⚠️ <strong style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: inherit; color: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold">注意</strong>：安装完成之后需要重启系统</p>
</blockquote>
<hr style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; border: none; -webkit-transform-origin: 0 0; -webkit-transform: scale(1, 0.5); transform-origin: left top; transform: scale(1, 0.5); height: 1px; margin: 2em 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0))">
<h2 id="5" style="text-align: center; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 20.8px; display: table; padding: 0.3em 1.2em; margin: 4em auto 2em; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold; border-radius: 8px 24px; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06)" data-heading="true">第二步：安装 Linux 子系统</h2>
<h3 id="6" style="text-align: left; line-height: 2.4em; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 19.2px; padding-left: 12px; border-left: 4px solid rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); margin: 2em 8px 0.75em 0; color: hsl(var(--foreground)); font-weight: bold; border-radius: 6px" data-heading="true">方法一：Microsoft Store 安装</h3>
<ol style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; padding-left: 1.5em; margin-left: 0; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">1. 打开 Microsoft Store</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">2. 搜索 "Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS"</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">3. 点击"获取"或"安装"按钮</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="7" style="text-align: left; line-height: 2.4em; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 19.2px; padding-left: 12px; border-left: 4px solid rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); margin: 2em 8px 0.75em 0; color: hsl(var(--foreground)); font-weight: bold; border-radius: 6px" data-heading="true"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1687216/202510/1687216-20251029160215017-819973137.png" alt="image">方法二：PowerShell 命令安装</h3>
<ol style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; padding-left: 1.5em; margin-left: 0; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">1. 以管理员身份打开 PowerShell</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">2. 查询可安装的 Linux 发行版：</li>
</ol>
<pre class="language-powershell highlighter-hljs"><code>wsl&nbsp;--list&nbsp;--online</code></pre>
<ol style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; padding-left: 1.5em; margin-left: 0; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: hsl(var(--foreground))"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1687216/202510/1687216-20251029160227005-1061166185.png" alt="image"></li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">3. 安装所需的发行版（例如 Ubuntu 22.04）：</li>
</ol>
<pre class="language-powershell highlighter-hljs"><code>wsl&nbsp;--install&nbsp;Ubuntu-22.04</code></pre>
<h3 id="8" style="text-align: left; line-height: 2.4em; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 19.2px; padding-left: 12px; border-left: 4px solid rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); margin: 2em 8px 0.75em 0; color: hsl(var(--foreground)); font-weight: bold; border-radius: 6px" data-heading="true">初始设置</h3>
<ul style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; list-style: none; padding-left: 1.5em; margin-left: 0; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">• 如果使用 Store 安装，直接打开应用即可自动初始化</li>
<li><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1687216/202510/1687216-20251029160241511-376280458.png" alt="image"></li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">&nbsp;</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">• 如果使用 <code style="accent-color: auto; align-self: auto; alignment-baseline: auto; anchor-name: none; anchor-scope: none; animation: 0s ease 0s 1 normal none running none; animation-composition: replace; animation-range: normal; animation-range-end: normal; animation-range-start: normal; animation-timeline: auto; app-region: none; appearance: none; aspect-ratio: auto; backdrop-filter: none; backface-visibility: visible; background: none left top / auto repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); background-blend-mode: normal; baseline-shift: 0px; baseline-source: auto; block-size: auto; border: 0 solid rgba(229, 229, 229, 1); border-block: 0px solid #e5e5e5; border-block-color: #e5e5e5; border-block-end: 0px solid #e5e5e5; <h2 id="9" style="text-align: center; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 20.8px; display: table; padding: 0.3em 1.2em; margin: 4em auto 2em; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold; border-radius: 8px 24px; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06)" data-heading="true">第三步：配置 Windows 和子系统网络互通</h2>
<h3 id="10" style="text-align: left; line-height: 2.4em; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 19.2px; padding-left: 12px; border-left: 4px solid rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); margin: 2em 8px 0.75em 0; color: hsl(var(--foreground)); font-weight: bold; border-radius: 6px" data-heading="true">为什么要配置网络互通？</h3>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">如果不进行此配置，Windows 的代理设置在 Linux 子系统中将不可用，可能导致网络访问问题。</p>
<h3 id="11" style="text-align: left; line-height: 2.4em; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 19.2px; padding-left: 12px; border-left: 4px solid rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); margin: 2em 8px 0.75em 0; color: hsl(var(--foreground)); font-weight: bold; border-radius: 6px" data-heading="true">配置步骤</h3>
<ol style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; padding-left: 1.5em; margin-left: 0; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">1. 进入当前用户文件夹：</li>
</ol>
<pre class="language-bash highlighter-hljs"><code>%USERPROFILE%</code></pre>
<ol style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; padding-left: 1.5em; margin-left: 0; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">

<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">3. 添加以下配置内容：</li>
</ol>
<pre class="language-ini highlighter-hljs"><code># 全局 WSL2 配置文件，路径：%USERPROFILE%\.wslconfig
# 修改后需执行 wsl --shutdown 再重启 WSL 才会生效

[wsl2]
# 是否启用调试控制台（true=开启，false=关闭）
debugConsole=false

# 以下字段属于实验性功能，需要 Win11 22H2+ 以及 WSL 2.0.0+
[experimental]
# 网络模式： mirrored=镜像主机网络，默认 NAT
networkingMode=mirrored

# DNS 隧道： true=让 WSL 通过主机解析 DNS，避免国内常见 DNS 污染
dnsTunneling=true

# 让 Windows 防火墙规则对 WSL 生效（默认 false）
firewall=true

# 自动继承 Windows 系统代理设置
autoProxy=true</code></pre>
<ol style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; padding-left: 1.5em; margin-left: 0; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">4. 保存文件后，在 PowerShell 中执行以下命令重启 WSL：</li>
</ol>
<pre class="language-powershell highlighter-hljs"><code>wsl&nbsp;--shutdown</code></pre>
<hr style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; border: none; -webkit-transform-origin: 0 0; -webkit-transform: scale(1, 0.5); transform-origin: left top; transform: scale(1, 0.5); height: 1px; margin: 2em 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0))">
<h2 id="12" style="text-align: center; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 20.8px; display: table; padding: 0.3em 1.2em; margin: 4em auto 2em; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold; border-radius: 8px 24px; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06)" data-heading="true">第四步：进入 Linux 子系统并安装 Kimi CLI</h2>
<h3 id="13" style="text-align: left; line-height: 2.4em; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 19.2px; padding-left: 12px; border-left: 4px solid rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); margin: 2em 8px 0.75em 0; color: hsl(var(--foreground)); font-weight: bold; border-radius: 6px" data-heading="true">1. 进入 Linux 子系统</h3>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">打开 PowerShell 或 CMD，输入：</p>
<pre class="language-bash highlighter-hljs"><code>wsl</code></pre>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: hsl(var(--foreground))"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1687216/202510/1687216-20251029160445496-1611368838.png" alt="image"></p>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">成功进入子系统后，切换到用户主目录：</p>
<pre class="language-bash highlighter-hljs"><code>cd&nbsp;~</code></pre>
<h3 id="14" style="text-align: left; line-height: 2.4em; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 19.2px; padding-left: 12px; border-left: 4px solid rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); margin: 2em 8px 0.75em 0; color: hsl(var(--foreground)); font-weight: bold; border-radius: 6px" data-heading="true">2. 安装 Kimi CLI</h3>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">参考文档：<span style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; color: rgba(87, 107, 149, 1)">Kimi CLI 使用说明 | Kimi For Coding<sup>[23]</sup></span></p>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">首先安装 uv（Python 包管理器）：</p>
<pre class="language-bash highlighter-hljs"><code>curl&nbsp;-LsSf&nbsp;https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh&nbsp;|&nbsp;sh</code></pre>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">安装 uv 后，使用以下命令安装 Kimi CLI：</p>
<pre class="language-bash highlighter-hljs"><code>uv&nbsp;tool&nbsp;install&nbsp;--python&nbsp;3.13&nbsp;kimi-cli</code></pre>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">验证安装是否成功：</p>
<pre class="language-bash highlighter-hljs"><code>kimi&nbsp;--version</code></pre>
<h3 id="15" style="text-align: left; line-height: 2.4em; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 19.2px; padding-left: 12px; border-left: 4px solid rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); margin: 2em 8px 0.75em 0; color: hsl(var(--foreground)); font-weight: bold; border-radius: 6px" data-heading="true">3. 启动 Kimi CLI</h3>
<pre class="language-bash highlighter-hljs"><code>kimi</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1687216/202510/1687216-20251029160502454-1098527230.png" alt="image"></p>
<h3 id="16" style="text-align: left; line-height: 2.4em; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 19.2px; padding-left: 12px; border-left: 4px solid rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); margin: 2em 8px 0.75em 0; color: hsl(var(--foreground)); font-weight: bold; border-radius: 6px" data-heading="true">4. 配置 Kimi CLI</h3>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">在 Kimi CLI 中输入：</p>
<pre class="language-bash highlighter-hljs"><code>/setup</code></pre>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: hsl(var(--foreground))"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1687216/202510/1687216-20251029160534414-1678903267.png" alt="image"></p>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">选择第一个选项，输入 API 密钥。</p>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">API 密钥获取方式：</p>
<ol style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; padding-left: 1.5em; margin-left: 0; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">1. 访问 Kimi 官网</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">2. 登录账户</li>
<li style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; display: block; margin: 0.5em 8px; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">3. 在设置或开发者页面找到 API 密钥</li>
</ol>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1687216/202510/1687216-20251029160540652-1859821918.png" alt="image"></section>
<section style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px">          <img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1687216/202510/1687216-20251029160544339-524247365.png" alt="image"><br>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">将复制的密钥粘贴到 Kimi CLI 中，配置即完成。</p>
<hr style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; border: none; -webkit-transform-origin: 0 0; -webkit-transform: scale(1, 0.5); transform-origin: left top; transform: scale(1, 0.5); height: 1px; margin: 2em 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0))">
<h2 id="17" style="text-align: center; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 20.8px; display: table; padding: 0.3em 1.2em; margin: 4em auto 2em; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold; border-radius: 8px 24px; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06)" data-heading="true">第五步：Kimi CLI 与 Visual Studio/Visual Studio Code 同时开发</h2>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">在 Linux 子系统中，导航到 Windows 项目目录：</p>
<pre class="language-bash highlighter-hljs"><code>cd&nbsp;/mnt/c/project
#&nbsp;mnt&nbsp;是共享的文件夹 #&nbsp;c&nbsp;是你的&nbsp;C&nbsp;盘，d&nbsp;是你的&nbsp;D&nbsp;盘 #&nbsp;project&nbsp;是你的开发文件夹</code></pre>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; margin: 1.5em 8px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: hsl(var(--foreground))">这样就可以在 Windows 中使用 Visual Studio/Visual Studio Code 进行开发，同时在 Linux 子系统中使用 Kimi CLI 提供智能编程辅助，实现高效的跨平台开发体验。</p>
<hr style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 16px; border: none; -webkit-transform-origin: 0 0; -webkit-transform: scale(1, 0.5); transform-origin: left top; transform: scale(1, 0.5); height: 1px; margin: 2em 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0))">
<h2 id="18" style="text-align: center; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 20.8px; display: table; padding: 0.3em 1.2em; margin: 4em auto 2em; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); font-weight: bold; border-radius: 8px 24px; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06)" data-heading="true">常见问题与解决方案</h2>
<h3 id="19" style="text-align: left; line-height: 2.4em; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif; font-size: 19.2px; padding-left: 12px; border-left: 4px solid rgba(0, 152, 116, 1); margin: 2em 8px 0.75em 0; color: hsl(var(--foreground)); font-weight: bold; border-radius: 6px" data-heading="true">Q: 网络代理不生效</h3>
<p style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.75; font-family: Optima-Regular, Optima, PingFangSC-light, PingFangTC-light, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, Cambria, Cochin, Georgia, Times, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, serif;
